[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra III.52 (Vibhūtipāda) — Kṣaṇatatkramayoḥ saṃyamād vivekajaṃ jñānam | Pages 675-677]

ātī laukikānāṃ vyutthita-darśanānāṃ
vastu-svarūpa iva–avabhāsate / Kṣaṇas tu vastu-patitaḥ krama-avalambī / Kramaś ca kṣaṇa-
ānantarya-ātmā / Taṃ kāla-vidaḥ kāla ity ācakṣate yoginaḥ / Na ca dvau kṣaṇau saha
bhavataḥ, kramaś na dvayoḥ sahabhuvoḥ, asaṃbhavāt, pūrvasmād uttara-bhāvino
1720 yad
ānantaryaṃ kṣaṇasya sa kramaḥ / Tasmād vartamāna eva–ekaḥ kṣaṇo na pūrva-uttara-kṣaṇāḥ
santi–iti / Tasmān na–asti tat-samāhāraḥ / Ye tu bhūta-bhāvinaḥ kṣaṇās te pariṇāma-anvitā
vyākhyeyāḥ / Tena–ekena kṣaṇena kṛtsno lokaḥ pariṇāmam anubhavati / Tat-kṣaṇa-upārūḍhāḥ
khalv amī sarve dharmā�
